name: wright
description: A gameplay harness for game-wide sandbox pre-production, mission-focused production and playable human reviews.

interface.shortDescription: Prototype the game, then build the selected mission.
interface.longDescription: Wright maps the whole game into playable rooms in one prototype sandbox, with contextual debug UI, equipment stand-ins and mission concept coverage. Production focuses on the selected mission. Bounded packets preserve evidence, scope and human-reviewed phase handoffs. Local Codex preview; no comparative performance claim.
defaultPrompt: Use Wright to plan the whole game's mechanics and concepts, then prototype them in rooms of one sandbox level with debug UI.
Resume a Wright packet and reconcile its saved progress.
